title: The Gear Maze
text: A hall of turning gears, each as tall as a house, their teeth grinding past each other with a sound like the world's slow chewing. Oil drips from above. The only way through is between them, and there are bones in the oil.

options.label: The sharpest times the turning gears, and counts every step.

outcomes.text: Step by counted step, they lead you through without a scratch. The bones in the oil were not so careful.

options.label: Rush through between the teeth, and trust your feet.

outcomes.text: You make it through, mostly, with oil and blood on your coats.
A sleeve catches, and the arm inside it with it. The gears do not stop.

options.label: Jam the gears with a beam, and stop their chewing for good.

outcomes.text: They grind to a halt with a shriek. The whole ruin shudders awake to see what stopped them.
